description: Approved alert tuning rules. Principals are stored only as SHA-256 hashes of the normalised identity. Every rule must have a justification, an approver and an expiry date.

rules.justification: Service enablement during the initial setup of the lab GCP project on 15 Nov 2026 by the project owner. Verified in the audit log: all four EnableService calls followed the CreateProject event within 3 seconds. The rule worked as designed; the activity was authorised.

IAM policy change on 21 Nov 2026 by the project owner to enable Admin Read Data Access audit logs for the IAM and Cloud Resource Manager APIs. Only auditConfigs were added; a pre-change check confirmed role bindings were unchanged.
Authorised detection validation test on 21 Nov 2026: the project owner ran a scripted IAM permission discovery sequence to validate BEHAV-005 on real Data Access logs. The rule fired as intended.
